violations.title: Cooking Raw Animal Foods, Minimum of 165F
violations.observation: The following poultry item was not cooked to a sufficient temperature and/or time to eliminate pathogenic bacteria: Grilled chicken=155F to 178F,
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods such as poultry, wild game animals, stuffed fish, stuffed meat, stuffed pasta, stuffed poultry, stuffed ratites, or stuffing containing any of these raw animal foods shall be cooked to a minimum internal temperature of 165F for at least 15 seconds. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. The chicken was cooked for additional time, to 168F.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at the ONLINE station, was north proving adequate hot water temperature. This sink failed to meet the minimum hot water temperature of 100F. The observed temperature was 89F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. repair or adjust the temperature of the hot water at this sink to at least 100F, within the next 10 days. A follow-up inspection to verify compliance will be conducted.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Equipment Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: The interior surfaces of the mechanical warewashing machine are soiled that may decrease the effectiveness of the unit.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine, the compartments of sinks, basins, or other receptacles used for washing and rinsing equipment, utensils, or raw foods, or laundering wiping cloths and drainboards or other equipment used to substitute for drainboards shall be cleaned before use, throughout the day at a frequency necessary to prevent recontamination of equipment and utensils and to ensure that the equipment performs its intended function and if used at least every 24 hours.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the floor drain covers were not in place and the drain screens were also missing.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Install the screens and covers securely in place.
